# Information Data-Modeling Standards

This directory contains standards for canonical data modeling across bounded contexts — ensuring a data shape used by more than one context has a single source of truth rather than drifting across services.
page_texts.4:
[standards/information/data-modeling/README.md#std-inf-dm-001-canonical-model--published-language-standard]

### STD-INF-DM-001: Canonical Model & Published-Language Standard

Mandates that any shape shared across two or more bounded contexts be authored once as a canonical JSON Schema 2020-12 definition in a shared `_components/` library, `$ref`'d (never inlined) by every consuming contract, with exactly one owning context and consistent enum value sets.
page_texts.5:
[standards/information/data-modeling/README.md#purpose]

## Purpose

These standards ensure:
- One canonical definition per shared entity — no divergent copies across services
- A single owning (published-language) context per shared shape
- Cross-context enum and schema consistency, enforced by the architecture health check
